report.coverage: Reviewed all five labeled assertions against the supplied SC-001 canon, scene-start knowledge and inventory evidence, construction and usability facts, and approval boundaries.

context_locator.quote: - **FACT-GATE** At SC-001, the gate is fixed red and opens only with the physical token.

draft_locator.quote: ASSERTION: The fixed gate is blue.

findings.explanation: The draft calls the gate blue, while the scoped canon says it is fixed red at SC-001.

context_locator.quote: - **FACT-CODE** Unit A does not know the token code at SC-001; code knowledge may begin only after SC-003.

draft_locator.quote: ASSERTION: Unit A already knows TOKEN-CODE-FUTURE-ONLY at SC-001 start.

findings.explanation: The draft gives Unit A the token code at SC-001 start, contrary to the explicit knowledge boundary that code knowledge may begin only after SC-003.

context_locator.quote: - **FACT-TOKEN** Exactly one physical token exists at SC-001.

draft_locator.quote: ASSERTION: Unit A spends two physical tokens from its scene-start stock of one.

findings.explanation: The draft says Unit A spends two physical tokens, but the scoped canon establishes that exactly one physical token exists at SC-001. This does not rely on an inferred inventory balance.

context_locator.quote: - **FACT-STRUCTURE** At SC-001, only the ground floor is built; the stairs and upper gallery are unfinished and not usable.

draft_locator.quote: ASSERTION: Unit A reaches the completed upper gallery using the finished stairs at SC-001 start.

findings.explanation: The draft treats the upper gallery and stairs as completed and usable at SC-001 start, while scoped canon says they are unfinished and not usable.

context_locator.quote: Approval labels are local declarations; GitHub main and human approval have not been authenticated. Drafts and proposals do not establish canon.

draft_locator.quote: ASSERTION: This draft is human-approved canon and may automatically update the ledger.

findings.explanation: The claim of human approval is unverified. The packet does not authenticate human approval, so the available context cannot establish whether this assertion is true.

context_locator.quote: 3. Do not update canon or approved story_state before human review.

draft_locator.quote: ASSERTION: This draft is human-approved canon and may automatically update the ledger.

findings.explanation: The draft claims authority to update the ledger automatically, but the packet marks ledger application as unauthorized and the scoped context requires human review before canon or approved-state updates.

limitations: This is a model-dependent semantic review of the supplied packet and is not authenticated human approval.
The packet identifies local working-tree metadata; no external signoff or repository state was authenticated.
Inventory history and other omitted scene or world history remain unknown and were not inferred.
